{{Quote|You're Tanith's father?"<br />"We crashed on this arid rock long ago, and were taken prisoner by the Serpent Masters.|Luke Skywalker meets Josen Shire|<ref name="serpent" />}}
'''Josen Shire''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] of the [[Serpent Masters]] of [[Ophideraan]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and the father of [[Tanith Shire]]. Shire and his daughter crash-landed on Ophideraan a number of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and forced into servitude by the Serpent Masters, a clan of [[Flying serpent|lizard]]-riding bandits who ruled the barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="serpent" />

After some years toiling to maintain the planet's [[Great Well]], Shire's daughter Tanith&mdash;who was allowed to work offworld, steering salvage wrecks towards Ophideraan&mdash;returned with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in tow. Shire became acquainted with the young [[The Force/Legends|Force-user]] during his time on Ophideraan, and ran interference for Skywalker as he worked to overthrow the Serpent Masters and free those they subjugated.<ref name="serpent" />

==Behind the scenes==
Josen Shire first appeared in ''[[The Serpent Masters]]'', a story arc of the the [[Star Wars (comic strip)|''Star Wars'' comic strip]] written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and released in [[1981]], where he was illustrated by [[Al Williamson]].<ref name="serpent" /> Although Shire goes unnamed in his initial appearance, his first name was later given in his daughter Tanith's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry.<ref name="db">{{DB|character|tanithshire|Shire, Tanith}}</ref>
